source_text: Terra quae remanet multa — Philisthiim et regiones. Senectus Iesu; adhuc certamina. In ecclesia remanent gentes vitiorum expugnandae.
pass_a_gloss: Land which remains much — Philistines and regions. Old-age of-Jesus; still contests. In church remain nations of-vices to-be-stormed.
pass_b_english: [[Much land remains — Philistines and regions >> Bible:Joshua 13:1-6]]. Jesus is old; contests remain. In the church vice-nations still await storming.
